novelty: Mostly known theorems independently cross-tested; strongest synthesis is dense-DAG monotonicity plus triangular-unitary obstruction

spinors.limitations: Flux, 2D topology, gamma matrices and mass chosen externally; reflection positivity, 3+1 chirality and anomalies untested

gravity.exact_claim: For nonnegative edge weights, adding any forward edge strictly raises Tr(G dagger(G)); this biases positive action/weights toward dense DAGs
gravity.limitations: Labeled topological order fixed; graphs need not be transitively closed; this is not a continuum causal-set gravity measure

gauge.limitations: The link unitaries and causal paths are inputs, no Yang-Mills kinetic action derived

temporal_qutrit.limitations: Three-party GHZ coherence is not itself a causal process-tensor quantum-memory witness; arbitrary intermediate interventions not tested

matter_flavor.limitations: Heavy couplings arbitrary; no physical Yukawa or CKM fit; rank-one no-go previously identified in repo

unitary_causal_dilation.theorem: Finite triangular unitary matrix must be diagonal; nontrivial forward causal propagation as an operation needs layered time evolution, monitoring/postselection, or dilation
unitary_causal_dilation.limitations: Dilation adds coherent ancilla and reverse amplitudes in larger Hilbert space; does not derive a unique microscopic dynamics
